Read-only review (Opus). Not built here.

Verdict: Ready to merge.

Checks:
- The diff adds two `//!` lines to each of three files, and nothing else. No test code or product code changes.
- Format: each new paragraph starts with `Gate map (#2400): covers ...` and continues on the next `//!` line. This is the same form as the other app suites, for example `Gate map (M4.4): covers app::operation (area, ...`. `scan::gate_map` (`xtask/src/scan.rs:138`) reads the paragraph until the next line that does not start with `//!`. That is the blank line 4 in each file, so the paragraph is complete.
- `crates/app/tests/corner_relief.rs:2-3` names `app::operation::corner_relief`, `app::operation::corner_relief_sim` and `app::commands`. The two operation files exist on main (`crates/app/src/operation/mod.rs:193-194`). The suite imports `camcraft_app::commands::{CreateOperation, GenerateOperation}`.
- `crates/app/tests/corner_relief_safety.rs:2-3` names `app::operation::corner_relief` and `app::commands`. The suite imports `camcraft_app::commands::{CreateOperation, ImportModel}`.
- `crates/app/tests/corner_relief_serialization.rs:2-3` names `app::project`, `app::mcp` and `app::operation::corner_relief`. The suite imports `camcraft_app::project` and `camcraft_app::mcp::Server`.
- No line names a module from the `moved` list of `no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app` (`xtask/src/gate_maps_tests.rs:292`). The three suites now have a Gate map, so the `unmapped` list of that test becomes empty.
- The PR body has `Changelog: none` and `Fixes #2905`. A comment-only test change needs no changelog row.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main origin/pr-2907` gives no conflict.

Note, not a blocker: the suites also import `camcraft_app::machining2d`, `cl`, `geo2d` and `verify` (re-exports of other crates). The maps do not name `motion::machining2d`. Thus a change to the pocket generator in `camcraft-motion` does not select these suites in the quick tier. A later issue can add that if it is necessary.
